hypothesis: candidate_pool: broad liquid-universe companies whose latest quarterly 10-Q is filed abnormally early versus the same company's own same-fiscal-quarter filing-lag norm may drift up over the next 10 trading days, because prompt interim disclosure proxies clean books / management confidence and is a materially different disclosure-timing field from rejected annual 10-K early filing.

prediction.confidence_reason: exp-20260617-020 closed the annual 10-K breadth caveat and explicitly allowed a materially different quarterly 10-Q timeliness field. Quarterly filing promptness is PIT/free and event-timed, but shorter filing-lag variance may be noisy and broad-event breadth can regress old_thin or fail accepted distribution comparator.

execution_envelope.liquidity_source: price >= $10 and ADV20 >= $50M from PIT OHLCV (no momentum gate)
execution_envelope.order_semantics: observe-only next-session-open paper entry; no broker order
execution_envelope.portfolio_displacement: none unless a later shared helper and activation gate pass
execution_envelope.kill_switch: trade_enabled remains false; no production adapter changes
execution_envelope.failure_handling: missing raw SEC quarterly 10-Q filing history, fewer than 2 prior same-quarter filings, missing CIK mapping, missing OHLCV, missing next open, or missing 10d exit rejects the paper candidate

production_impact.parity_note: This experiment changes no production code. A positive result is only a replay lead until a shared default-off helper computes the same PIT quarterly 10-Q filed-lag history, abnormally-early-vs-same-quarter-own-norm gate, light liquidity gate, cooldown, next-open paper entry, 10-day exit, costs, and concentration controls in both historical replay and daily production.

post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: The broad liquid-universe quarterly 10-Q filing-timeliness source did not clear Gate 4 (failed: window_ev_regression, window_pnl_regression, drawdown_drift_too_high, accepted_distribution_ev_not_beaten, accepted_distribution_pnl_not_beaten). This tests a materially different disclosure-timing field from the rejected annual 10-K early-filing bundle: true quarter-duration Q1/Q2/Q3 10-Q rows are compared only against the same company's prior same-fiscal-quarter filing-lag norm. The result is not retained or promoted.
post_run_reflection.outcome_summary: Aggregate EV delta +0.4060; aggregate PnL delta $+5,534.90; max drawdown drift +0.0052; 161 paper trades.
post_run_reflection.forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: Do not retry by sweeping quarterly earliness-days, current-lag cap, prior same-quarter count, event age, price/ADV liquidity floors, quarter-duration bounds, top-N, hold days, cooldown, or notional on these frozen windows.
post_run_reflection.new_evidence_required: If this fixed quarterly 10-Q bundle fails, do not retry by sweeping earliness-days, current-lag cap, prior same-quarter count, event age, price/ADV liquidity floors, quarter-duration bounds, top-N, hold days, cooldown, or notional. A valid retry needs a materially different disclosure-timing field such as accelerated-filer-status change, NT 10-K/10-Q late-filing notices, segment/customer disclosure timing, or closed forward replacement-value rows.
